description: Defines a function to generate options for embed blocks in a rich text editor, importing dependencies and utilizing classes and functions related to embedding blocks and icons.

classes.name: BlockPickerOption
classes.description: A class representing an option in a block picker UI component, constructed with name and options including icon, keywords, and selection handler.

methods.name: GetEmbedsBlockOptions
methods.description: Generates and returns an array of BlockPickerOption instances based on embed blocks retrieved via GetEmbedsBlocks, tailored for a given LexicalEditor instance.
